note: Delivery precision baseline for #346 step 1, measured 2026-10-16 from the owner's database (read only) and Claude Code and Codex transcripts. Labels by Claude and Codex independently; a disagreement is unknown. The bar was fixed in the plan before labelling. Reported on #346: https://github.com/iroha924/sphica/issues/346#issuecomment-6211102236; corrected after the full-diff review: https://github.com/iroha924/sphica/issues/346#issuecomment-6211346726

inputs.database: ~/.sphica/sphica.db, read live with sqlite3 -readonly and the reader connection; the pinned population stands in for its contents

population.definition: delivery_unit pairs of the project's delivery rows with outcome emitted and from <= at < to, every event, main and subagent, ordered by at, delivery id, unit id

sampling.method: pinned pairs ordered by delivery time, delivery id, unit id, shuffled with mulberry32, first 80 (server/evals/delivery/sample.ts --sample)

labels.useful: the record's content bears on what the agent was doing at that moment: it stops a change that goes against it, tells a condition the work must keep, or helps avoid a known failure
labels.irrelevant: it has nothing to do with the work at that moment
labels.unknown: undecided, no transcript, or the two labellers disagree

classes.rule: plan: the record's text decides the scope or approach of one named piece of work (an issue, pull request, bundle, release, or task) rather than a lasting rule; finished: that work's issue was closed or its pull request merged (or its release published) before the delivery. Records whose text states a lasting rule are standing even when they name an issue as an example. Kinds other than decision and constraint are other.
